rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AGTS Sovereign Gateway by ObligationSign is a governed MCP server that subjects every tool invocation to five evaluation gates—semantic validity, financial validity, operational safety, policy admission, and cryptographic finalization—before execution. All authorized actions are signed with hybrid Ed25519+SLH-DSA post-quantum signatures and anchored in an append-only Merkle transparency log, providing cryptographic audit trails suitable for EU AI Act, SOC 2, GDPR, DORA, and NIS2 compliance. The server exposes 64 tools across infrastructure, identity, governance, memory, billing, and orchestration layers, targeting regulated industries that require verifiable, auditable AI agent control.
